search_ai_meetup.name: Search & AI Meetup BR Landing Page
search_ai_meetup.description: Landing page developed for the Search & AI Meetup BR community. Built with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS, featuring a responsive layout, reusable component-based structure, i18n translation support, and subtle animations with Framer Motion.

planify_ai.name: Planify AI
planify_ai.description: Full-stack application that generates personalized study plans using AI. Includes Firebase authentication, a dashboard to manage plans and progress, a free credits system to limit usage, and a Node.js/Express backend with MongoDB and Prisma.
